prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Square premium mature painterly Slavic folklore encyclopedia illustration of ONE BABA YAGA selecting Ralston's source-attested LONG IRON NOSE manifestation (Russian Fairy Tales 1873 p147; Songs of Russian People 1872 p161 also records iron nose and strong sharp iron teeth). She is a very tall gaunt elderly supernatural hag with dishevelled grey hair sitting sideways on a low rough stool in the shadowed porch of her forest hut. Entire lean figure visible: one head, two arms/hands and two bony legs/feet, within frame. Essential nonhuman anatomy: an extraordinarily LONG LITERALLY IRON NOSE growing seamlessly from her face, dark hammered iron with an unmistakable metallic surface, extending out and downward almost the length of her forearm; a slightly open grin reveals a row of sharp IRON TEETH. These metal parts ARE HER ANATOMY, not a mask, prosthetic, beak, costume or object held before her face. Her eyes are alert and knowing, expression ambiguous threatening trickster and formidable tester. Faded modest earth-coloured dress, no revealing clothing, no exposed skeletal wounds. One hand rests on a wooden pestle, the other holds a plain broom; a wooden mortar rests next to her as source-compatible flight tools. Forest hut doorway and pine/birch roots visible; background chicken-legged hut may be hinted but the main focal subject is Baba Yaga herself, not house. Deep forest green shadows and antique-gold fire/moonlight, textured sophisticated brushwork. Make extraordinarily long metallic nose unmistakable, not a normal human nose. No horns, wings, animal ears, invented claws, monster tail, reptile face, extra limbs, little girl, other people, severed parts, skull fence, gore, blood, text, border, artist signature or watermark.
